rows.Bloom: Orange-red, yellow reverse. Yellow and orange bi-color.. None / no, none to mild fragrance. 26 to 30 petals. Average diameter 3.75". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Ovoid buds.

Trade reference: High and Magic

‘Crohimagi’ was the resultant seedling from a cross between two unnamed seedlings ‘P 203’ (seed parent) and ‘98-421’ (pollen parent) in May 1999. The seed parent is characterised by orange flower colour. The pollen parent is characterised by yellow flower colour. ...‘Crohimagi’ was bred by Ir. Theodorus Adrianus Segers, director of Preesman Royalty B.V. in Rijsenhout, The Netherlands.

First sold in Kenya in Oct 2004. First Australian sale May 2006.

Patent surrendered on September 19, 2013. European Union - Patent on 2004
